verdict.rationale: 2FAS says the source code for 2FAS Auth and 2FAS Pass is on GitHub, and it calls 2FAS Auth "open-source". However, 2FAS Pass is described only as "source-available", and no specific license is named, so the open-license part is confirmed for the Auth app alone. missing for 10: a named OSI-approved license, confirmation that 2FAS Pass is under an open (not merely source-available) license, independent verification of repository licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The source code of 2FAS Pass and 2FAS Auth is available on GitHub.
Source-available code ensures that every security feature we use can be verified by independent security experts.
You can easily take a look at our code - reflecting our transparent and user-first approach. Check out our GitHub repository
